text:
maya (partnerships): Quick update from today's vendor sync: they shipped a GA H100 image with a custom telemetry agent enabled by default. It fails our cert shim (hash mismatch) and vendor says it's part of a new QA pipeline.

trent (hw-ops): Can you paste the image id/checksum? lab can reimage a unit to repro, but need the manifest.

maya (partnerships): Image sha256: b7d4c9a8f2e1c3d9e5a1... (ref PRT-5077). Vendor claims it's signed but uses a nonstandard signing key.

trent (hw-ops): Nonstandard signing key = red flag for our CI. I'll try a repro reflash in lab and run our unsigned-stripper. ETA 5-7h.

jia (eng-platform): Heads-up: marketplace listing rollout is scheduled for 2027-10-01 09:00 PT. If certs aren't green by T-6h we'll have an automated hold.

harry (product): If we have to hold, marketing needs a fallback blurb. Can engineering propose a compatibility fallback? e.g., route H100 SKUs to MI300/Gaudi for first 48h.

anya (solutions): Routing fallback is doable with policy flags, but perf delta needs to be explicit. I'll draft a short playbook with policy JSON and opt-in toggle for customers.

vendor-bot: Vendor note: new telemetry collects thermal/power traces for internal analytics. Customer data not transmitted. (ticket#VND-331)
notes:
maya (partnerships): Action items: 1) trent repro + reimage + cert run; 2) anya draft routing playbook + policy snippet; 3) jia gate listing at T-6h if cert failing; 4) harry prepare two marketing blurbs (delayed vs fallback). Everyone update PRT-5077.

anya (solutions): Sample fallback policy snippet (in-repo):

`{ route_policy: "fallback_hw", priority: ["h100", "mi300", "gaudi"], latency_note: "p95 may increase by 30-120ms" }`

trent (hw-ops): If stripper doesn't work, we escalate to vendor for a properly signed GA image. Will report results in PRT-5077 by 3470016000.

jia (eng-platform): Will place hold and notify infra-runbook with #hold tag if not resolved.

harry (product): I'll draft messaging and post to this thread for approval.

maya (partnerships): Using this thread as canonical for embargo/announce decisions. Ping me once PRT-5077 updated. :thumbsup:
